# reset-counters-all

> Resets the hits counter of all rules in /ip/proxy/cache. For an overview, see Web Proxy.

-----------

## ip/proxy/cache/reset-counters-all 
**Type:** Command

Resets the `hits` counter of all rules in [`/ip/proxy/cache`](../cache/). For an overview, see [Web Proxy](../../../../network-management/proxy/web-proxy).
